content.value_statement: Teams often miss key docs across APIs, architecture, onboarding, and releases. This workflow organizes documentation tasks into clear phases with focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Plans documentation structure and style guidelines before writing starts.
Guides API documentation, OpenAPI specifications, references, and examples.
Organizes architecture documentation with C4 and Mermaid diagram prompts.
Supports README, setup guides, tutorials, and troubleshooting outlines.
Covers wiki, onboarding, process documentation, changelog, and release notes workflows.
Provides quality gates for APIs, diagrams, README files, comments, examples, and links.
limitations: It is a workflow guide and does not execute documentation tools by itself.
It depends on separate named skills that may not be installed.
Generated documentation still needs project-specific review and testing.
It does not verify links, examples, diagrams, or API accuracy automatically.

use_cases.title: Plan a Documentation Set
use_cases.description: Create a structured plan for APIs, architecture, user guides, and maintenance tasks.

use_cases.title: Document a Software Project
use_cases.description: Turn a codebase into README files, code comments, API references, and diagrams.

use_cases.title: Maintain Release Documentation
use_cases.description: Prepare changelogs, release notes, onboarding pages, and documentation quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Start a README
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a README outline for this project, including setup, usage, examples, and troubleshooting sections.

prompt_templates.title: Create API Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these endpoints and draft API documentation with authentication notes, request details, responses, and usage examples.

prompt_templates.title: Map Architecture Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an architecture documentation plan with C4 views, data flows, deployment notes, and diagram requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Run Documentation Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a full documentation workflow for planning, creation, review, publishing, maintenance, and quality gates.

output_examples.input: A team needs documentation for a new service.
output_examples.output: A phased documentation plan covering README content, API reference, architecture diagrams, setup steps, and ownership review.

output_examples.input: A project has endpoints but no API reference.
output_examples.output: An API documentation outline with endpoint groups, authentication guidance, request fields, response descriptions, and example coverage.

output_examples.input: A release needs user-facing notes and internal updates.
output_examples.output: A release documentation checklist with changelog items, release notes, updated wiki pages, and link validation tasks.

best_practices: Start with documentation scope, target audience, and acceptance criteria.
Use the workflow phases in order when creating a documentation set.
Review generated content against the quality gates before publishing.
anti_patterns: Skipping validation of commands, links, diagrams, and examples.
Asking for every documentation type when only one deliverable is needed.
Publishing generated docs without technical owner review.

faq.question: Does this skill generate documents by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides an AI assistant through documentation tasks and references related skills.

faq.question: Which documentation types does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers API docs, architecture docs, README files, code comments, user guides, wikis, and release notes.

faq.question: Can it create OpenAPI documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a phase for extracting endpoints, generating OpenAPI specs, and writing API references.

faq.question: Does it validate generated documentation?
faq.answer: No. Users should test examples, check links, review diagrams, and confirm technical accuracy.

faq.question: Can it support team knowledge bases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes wiki structure, onboarding pages, process documentation, and maintenance prompts.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code environments.
